comments:
General instruction on the generation of bodhicitta.

The author refers to the views of other scholars and bla mas who are not named in the text. Some of them are identified in glosses in (ID:4562); these include rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) ex013172025-11-2620-55-08 and Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) ex013172025-11-2620-55-18 , as well as the "three brothers" (sku mched gsum" ((ID:3829), (ID:7093), (ID:3830)) ex013072025-11-2708-17-15 . 
"Jo bo/Jo bo rje" (i.e., Atiśa (ID:3745)) is named in the main text - ex013072025-11-2621-00-59, ex013172025-11-2620-55-28, ex013072025-11-2708-20-45, ex013072025-11-2622-23-20 - and in an annotation ex013072025-11-2621-47-30 .
